from sklearn.datasets import load_diabetes
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, root_mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X, y = load_diabetes(return_X_y=True, as_frame=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
cols = ["bmi", "bp", "s5"]

model = LinearRegression().fit(X_train[cols], y_train)

pred = model.predict(X_test[cols])
mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, pred)
rmse = root_mean_squared_error(y_test, pred)
r2 = r2_score(y_test, pred)
print(f"MAE {mae:.1f}  RMSE {rmse:.1f}  R2 {r2:.3f}")

checks.test: pred is not None and len(pred) == len(y_test) and abs(float(pred[0]) - float(LinearRegression().fit(X_train[['bmi', 'bp', 's5']], y_train).predict(X_test[['bmi', 'bp', 's5']])[0])) < 1e-6
mae is not None and abs(float(mae) - float((y_test - LinearRegression().fit(X_train[['bmi', 'bp', 's5']], y_train).predict(X_test[['bmi', 'bp', 's5']])).abs().mean())) < 1e-6
rmse is not None and abs(float(rmse) - float(((y_test - LinearRegression().fit(X_train[['bmi', 'bp', 's5']], y_train).predict(X_test[['bmi', 'bp', 's5']])) ** 2).mean() ** 0.5)) < 1e-6
r2 is not None and 0.3 < float(r2) < 0.6 and float(rmse) >= float(mae)
